message:
Ah, storm season. Nothing like watching the clouds roll in while my family group chat lights up with messages like, "Do we have enough flashlights?" and "Who’s in charge of snacks?" ☔️ It's funny how a little weather can turn us into emergency prep experts overnight. I’ve learned that it helps to have a go-to resource for tips on what to do before, during, and after the storm hits. It’s a bit like a family playbook, minus the actual play. 

So, what’s your best tip for keeping calm when the skies get a little rough? I'd love to hear your tricks!
